claim_scores.rationale: Creates one `dspy.Predict('question -> answer')` and reuses it for all three calls, with call-time LM/adapter resolution via global/context settings.
The first outer call uses `chat_lm` with `ChatAdapter`, and the recorded system message is checked for `[[ ## question ## ]]`.
Inside `dspy.context`, the same predictor runs against `xml_lm` with `XMLAdapter`, and the system message is checked for `<question>` and against chat markers.
After the context exits, the third call reuses the same predictor with the default chat LM again, and the recorded post-context system message is asserted to contain chat markers.
It prints before/inside/after system messages and asserts chat markers on both outer calls, XML tags on the inner call, and absence of `[[ ## question ## ]]` in the XML call.
